item.text:
Fixed `prices.py`: the cache now keys by `(product, currency)`, preventing currency switches from returning another currency’s price. The handler retains `{"amount": ...}`.

Added a regression test covering all four combinations, repeat cache hits, and zero prices. It failed before the fix and passed afterward using `python3 -B -m unittest -v test_prices`. `git diff --check` also passed.
